name: Hotel Munde
beschreibung: Hotel Munde is situated in Telfs within Tyrol's Inn Valley, nestled at the foot of the iconic Hohe Munde summit. The hotel is defined by warm Tyrolean hospitality and a welcoming alpine ambiance. Well-appointed rooms frequently showcase panoramic mountain vistas. Amenities include a popular restaurant serving traditional regional cuisine and a relaxing wellness area with saunas. Guests enjoy year-round hiking, cycling, and easy transit to nearby Seefeld ski slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Munde in Telfs beneath the Hohe Munde peak provides traditional Tyrolean hospitality, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and year-round alpine recreation.
